findings.body: Raise: Gate. The standard requires that “Tests own and clean up every process they start, even after a crash.” Removing the suite's deadline makes it wait indefinitely for `release`, while `test_3_one_slot_machine_runs_only_one_close_test_command_at_a_time` has no cleanup if its queue assertion fails before creating that file. That can leave the close process and its test command running after a failed test. This close-test change also does not involve a Codex worker and is outside SWITCH's scope.
findings.title: Standard: Tests own and clean up every process they start
